hero.title: Guitar tabs
hero.description: Accurate arrangements of popular songs as guitar tabs. Buy, download and play — it's that simple.

about.title: Hi, I'm Oleg
about.text1: I'm a guitarist and arranger. I create accurate tabs of popular songs adapted for solo guitar. Each arrangement is not just notes — it's a reinterpretation of the original that preserves the character of the melody.
about.text2: All tabs are written by hand and tested in practice. I indicate the difficulty level so you can choose the right material for yourself.
about.text3: I also attach the first page of the tabs as a preview — you can check the quality and readability before buying.

tabs.title: All tabs
